name: Eagle F1 RS (tube type)

positioning: Tube-type Eagle F1 RS race clincher with the UUHP compound.

availability.note: Sold by Goodyear Bicycle Tires' US-dollar web store; mainland China and European availability not verified for this model.

caveats: Needs an inner tube; the tubeless-ready Eagle F1 RS is listed separately.
